summary: Planned one delivery iteration for Left menu 4. Evidence reviewed: the current dashboard shell uses a flat `navItems` array with Home, Feedback Request, and Configure; dashboard pages already exist for Home, Feedback Request, and Configure; the intake requires a two-level menu and prior readiness found no blocker. No tests were run for this planning action.

workItems.title: Define two-level dashboard navigation model
workItems.description: Replace the flat dashboard navigation definition with a model that supports Level 1 items and optional Level 2 children. Acceptance criteria: Level 1 items are Home, Feedback, and Configure; Feedback replaces the current Feedback Request label; Home has no submenu; Feedback has Provide Feedback and Past Feedbacks children; Configure has Profile and Change Password children; route and active-state metadata are explicit enough to support current page highlighting.

workItems.title: Implement Level 1 expand and collapse behavior
workItems.description: Update the dashboard sidebar so Level 1 items with children expand and collapse their Level 2 menu without changing main content. Acceptance criteria: clicking Feedback toggles its submenu visibility and does not navigate; clicking Configure toggles its submenu visibility and does not navigate; clicking Home navigates to the Home page because it has no submenu; expanded state is accessible through button semantics, aria-expanded, and clear focus behavior; the existing sidebar collapse control continues to work.

workItems.title: Add submenu destination pages with matching headings
workItems.description: Create or map dashboard content pages for each Level 2 option. Acceptance criteria: Provide Feedback opens a page whose main content heading is Provide Feedback; Past Feedbacks opens a page whose main content heading is Past Feedbacks; Profile opens a page whose main content heading is Profile; Change Password opens a page whose main content heading is Change Password; existing Feedback Request upload functionality is preserved under the Provide Feedback destination unless implementation review finds a better local mapping.

workItems.title: Style nested menu states consistently
workItems.description: Extend existing dashboard styles for nested menu rows, active child state, expanded parent state, and collapsed-sidebar display. Acceptance criteria: Level 2 items are visually subordinate to Level 1 items; active submenu selection is distinguishable; text does not overlap or wrap poorly at supported desktop widths; collapsed sidebar behavior remains usable through icons or titles; visual changes stay within the current dashboard design language.

workItems.title: Verify menu behavior with non-browser checks and planned browser coverage
workItems.description: Add or update focused tests where practical, and run allowed non-browser verification. Acceptance criteria: TypeScript verification uses `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false`; lint or unit checks are run if available and safe; browser and Playwright verification are explicitly left to the controller per task restriction; implementation notes identify the key paths checked manually through source review.
